text: Another knock sounded—this one from beneath their feet. The stone trembled.
speaker: Narrator

text: Zik stood and looked at the misaligned stones above them, the staircase that should not exist, and the wall built by frightened men who had mistaken burial for safety. They were not standing above the First City. They were standing above the first door. And the City was deeper.
speaker: Narrator

text: He opened his father's map. The lines on the page had changed. The staircase was no longer drawn as a straight descent. It continued downward past the point where the map had previously ended, past the foundations and the buried settlement. A new line had appeared beneath the old notation.
speaker: Narrator

text: I WAS WRONG ABOUT THE DEPTH.
speaker: Bel-iddin

text: Then another line formed beneath it.
speaker: Narrator

text: I WAS WRONG ABOUT WHAT WAS BENEATH US.
speaker: Bel-iddin

text: For several seconds there was only the sound of their breathing. Then a single knock came from directly beneath the floor.
speaker: Narrator

text: The map had not been wrong about the depth. It had been wrong about where the city began.
speaker: Narrator
